{{Quote|Swell. A luxury liner crawling with Imperials. And we're going to hold a little tea party for the Alliance ambassador and the Gaddrian ambassador right under their noses.|A Rebel Alliance operative|<ref name="TRG1" />}}
The '''Gaddrian ambassador''' was an individual<ref name="TRG1" /> who originated in<ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the Gaddrian [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]]|system=[[Gaddria system/Legends|Gaddria system]]|legends=1}}</ref> the [[Gaddria system/Legends|Gaddria system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Oricho sector/Legends|Oricho sector]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], they were the head of a faction of [[Senator/Legends|senators]] of the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]]<ref name="TRG1" />&mdash;which was [[Dissolution of the Imperial Senate/Legends|dissolved]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>&mdash;that was sympathetic to the Alliance.<ref name="TRG1" />

{{RPGseed}}
At one point during that conflict, the Gaddrian [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]] agreed to meet with an [[Unidentified Alliance ambassador|ambassador]] of the Alliance's [[Alliance Civil Government/Legends|provisional government]] in order to discuss the creation of a fifth column within the Empire in order to remove [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] from office and restore the power of the Senate. The meeting was to take place aboard the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] ''[[Silver Star]]'' while the surrounding affluent and powerful passengers were relaxing and enjoying the cruise, and the Alliance assigned a team of operatives, including the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Roark Garnet/Legends|Roark Garnet]], to pose as [[Noble/Legends|aristocrats]] while tasked with ensuring the security of the meeting and the safety of its participants.<ref name="TRG1" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Gaddrian ambassador was first mentioned in "[[The Lap of Luxury]]," a [[roleplaying game]] adventure idea included in the [[1987]] [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|rulebook]] for the first edition of [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. This article assumes the scenario plays out as described.<ref name="TRG1" />
